title: MTX_Pranksgiving

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which prank did you like best?

nodes.text: Kay sneaks by the unsuspecting students and cuts through all the tie-lines!
Meanwhile, Kel slips the end of the rope around Howard's ankle.
The twins meet back at their original hiding place.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Mission accomplished! Now all we have to do is sit back and enjoy the show!
Kay coaxes the lizards inside crevices in the Spartan Academy float and conceals them beneath decorative autumn foliage.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Good lizards! Now promise to stay hidden until the parade starts, okay?
Kel scampers back over.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Great job. We should get out of here before the Spartan Academy guys come back.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: There we go!
Kay pours all the dirt inside the body of the butterfly float.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Perfect. Those girls are going to get it at the parade, for sure!
Kel scampers back over.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Great job. We should get out of here before the Monarch Prep girls come back.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Uh oh!
Kay accidentally spills the dirt on the ground and all over herself. She gets none at all on the Monarch Prep float.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Ew! I even got dirt `inside` my shoes...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew! I even got dirt [color=#3b78e2][i]inside[/i][/color] my shoes...

nodes.text: Kel scampers back over.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Oh. Well, there's no more time. We have to get out of here before the Monarch Prep girls come back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When my parents left for Europe, they promised they'd visit me every holiday, and now they're not coming.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I'm sure there's a perfectly good explanation...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course, there is... There always is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I know is that, when it matters most, they always let me down...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... $ZOE's really upset. I'm going to need to find a way to cheer her up.
Across town, Kay and Kel sneak around the dorms and onto the grounds of Monarch Prep...
From a hiding place behind a butterfly-shaped topiary, they spy on the Monarch Prep girls as they work on their Thanksgiving Day parade float.
Time to play as Kay and pull the final prank!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Whoa... This school is so girly, yet fashionable. We should totally go to school here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...And hang out with bratty fashion snobs all day?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right. These girls are probably pretty stuck up, and besides, it's not like Mom and Dad could afford to send us here, anyway...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Especially not with a new baby on the way...
Nearby, Paige and Penelope work on their float. It's a large monarch butterfly, and its wings are decorated with orange citrines and onyx gemstones.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously, are we done yet, Penelope? I want to get over to the Thanksgiving Day parade already.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I'm sorry this is so much work, Paige, but giant butterfly floats don't build themselves.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, I know, but it's just killing me to think about how thankful everyone in the crowd is going to be when they see me wearing this super-cute Pocahontas outfit.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: ...Right. Because that's what Thanksgiving is about... Us seeing `you` look hot.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Right. Because that's what Thanksgiving is about... Us seeing [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] look hot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly! I knew you'd agree with me!
Back in their hiding place, Kel grimaces.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ew! You were right! Some of these girls `are` really stuck up!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ew! You were right! Some of these girls [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] really stuck up!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't worry. We'll put them in their place.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Commence distraction!
Kel scampers off. A few seconds later, a fire alarm rings in the dorm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that the fire alarm...?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It is! And it's coming from the dorm!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The dorm?! Gulp... But that's where all my dresses are!
The Monarch Prep girls race off. When the coast is clear, Kay sneaks over to the float.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now to put all this Wilson High dirt to good use by stuffing it inside the butterfly float...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: When the Monarch Prep girls activate the wings at the parade, they'll be showered with dirt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, they've been in Europe for a long time now, and you must miss them pretty terribly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard... I knew you'd understand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not a problem?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course not. I mean, you still get to have turkey and gravy with your Aunt, and after that, you can come over to my place for dessert!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's all Thanksgiving means to you...? `Food?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's all Thanksgiving means to you...? [color=#3b78e2][i]Food?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ..Uh, no. It also means whatever you think it means... Which in this case happens to be... Um, uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, Thanksgiving is about taking time to be grateful for what you have... Sniffle... I guess I just wanted my parents to be grateful for me.
Meanwhile, across town, Kay and Kel crawl beneath a fence and into Steph's backyard.
From a hiding place behind a tree, they spy on the Wilson High crew as they construct their Thanksgiving Day parade float!
You guessed it! It's time to play as Kay and pull your next great prank!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Weird! That's their float? What is it? An anthill?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Shh, just watch.
Tom Prince scowls.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unimpressive. If I'd wanted to see a pile of dirt with a hole in the middle, I would've visited Skazz's place.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey! My place doesn't have any holes!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Quiet, Tom. No one cares what you think. We all remember the pranks you pulled on our school back when you went to Spartan Academy.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Besides, Steph was just about to tell us about our float. It's, um... A volcano, right?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: For the last time. This `isn't` a volcano.
nodes.text_bbcode: For the last time. This [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] a volcano.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: This is a badger den, and when I press this button on my remote control, our mascot, Barry the Badger, will pop out and wave to the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: ...An actual badger?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: No, an `animatronic` badger.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, an [color=#3b78e2][i]animatronic[/i][/color] badger.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Heh. Cool. I love cartoons!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Skazz, animatronic means... Oh, nevermind. Here. Just see for yourself.
Steph presses a button on her remote. There is a whirring sound from inside the float, and then an animatronic Barry the Badger pops out and waves!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Kzzt! H-h-happy Thanksgiving, folks!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey! That `is` really cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] really cool!

nodes.text: Back in their hiding place, Kay grins mischievously...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kel, I'm ready to prank this float, but first, I need you to...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Create a distraction? No problem!
Kel crawls under the fence and disappears. A few seconds later, a massive crash can be heard nearby!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh...? What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I don't know, but we better check it out!
The Wilson High students race off. When the coast is clear, Kay sneaks over to the badger den.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now to put this spear Kel borrowed from Spartan Academy to good use...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I'll drive it right through the heart of the Wilson High mascot, and then hide the badger in its den!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Stab and skewer!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hi-`YAHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi-[color=#3b78e2][i]YAHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kay stabs the Grecian spear straight through the chest of the animatronic Barry the Badger!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Kzzt! Error! Kzzt! Does not compute!
Kay then shoves the animatronic Barry the Badger back down into its den, hiding both the broken mascot and the Grecian spear from view. A moment later, Kel crawls back in under the fence.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Great, but we should get out of here before the Wilson High crew comes back.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hi-`YAHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi-[color=#3b78e2][i]YAHHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Kay tries to stab the Grecian spear straight through the chest of the animatronic Barry the Badger...
But the spear splits right in half!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What...?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Stupid piece of junk... It didn't even leave a mark!
Kel crawls back in under the fence.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, there's no more time. We have to get out of here before the Wilson High crew comes back.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sure, just help me grab one of the bags of dirt they used to build the badger den. We'll use it to prank Monarch Prep.
As Kay and Kel escape beneath the fence with their stolen bag of dirt, the Wilson High crew returns.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: ...Huh. Nobody was there. I guess the wind must've knocked over those pumpkins.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I don't know. Something about it felt suspicious to me.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Everything still looks okay. Let's get our float over to the town square for the Thanksgiving Day parade.
Across town, the Centerscore High students finish up work on their float.
Let's check back in with Howard and see what he's up to.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, everyone. Take a big step back.
$Scott twists the helium release valve. The giant Lyle the Lizard balloon inflates and stays tethered to the float!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yay! It worked. We'll definitely impress the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh, you can be certain of that. You see, I've precisely calibrated the balloon's buoyancy to maximize audience response.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Is that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Ooh! I like how it's floaty!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I rest my case.
Off to the side, Howard approaches $ZOE. She's turned away, talking on the phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Yes, of course, I understand... No, I just... No... Goodbye. I love you, too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, we're about finished up here. Do you want to ride to the town square with me or...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Yeah, I'm fine... I just... Sniffle... I just found out that my parents aren't coming to visit me for Thanksgiving.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, no... $ZOE, that's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Wait. Did you say 'one time'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, sure, I mean, it was just the one lesson, but don't worry, I pick things up really fast.
Howard takes two ends of a tie-line and begins to tie a knot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, so the rabbit goes into the hole... And then out of the hole... And if he sees his shadow... That's six more weeks of winter...?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that makes no sense, and you just tied a slip-knot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So we need a knot that will hold. Just... You know what? Nevermind. You stand over there and try not to touch anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Oh, okay.
While Howard stands off to the side, $ZOE sets to work expertly repairing the tie-lines...
Fifteen minutes later, she finishes up. $Scott and Angie come over to examine her work.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, it looks like you did a satisfactory job...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Although it did take way longer than it should've. We'll have to make up for lost time on the way to the town square.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, the first lesson they teach you is how to keep everything shipshape. I promise you, I've coiled a whole lot of rope.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, great! That sounds like a plan!
$ZOE ties knots in the tie-line while Howard coils the rope.
In no time at all, they're finished! $Scott and Angie come over to examine their work.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Good going, guys!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And you were fast, too! Believe it or not, we're actually ahead of schedule! We'll have plenty of time to get to the town square and get set up.
The panicked lizards squirm free of Kay's grasp and flee in all directions.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No! Bad lizards! Come back!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Grr! Dumb lizards. Maybe I should've borrowed the snakes instead.
Kel scampers back over.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Psst! Kay, did you finish the prank?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Oh. Well, there's no more time. We have to get out of here before the Spartan Academy guys come back.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The logic `is` indisputable...
nodes.text_bbcode: The logic [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] indisputable...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, it looks like the crowd agrees with you... For now. And as their elected representative, it's my duty to carry out their wishes...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But it's also my duty to protect them, so if those Wilson High guys so much as look at us funny...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This war is back on!
The Centerscore High students file outside to continue their Thanksgiving Day parade preparations. Howard and $ZOE lag a few steps behind.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Whew, that was close.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I'm still not sure I understand your reasons, Howard, but I do think that standing up to everybody was really brave.
$ZOE kisses Howard on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks.
Across town, Kay and Kel sneak past a guard station and enter the expansive grounds of Spartan Academy.
From a hiding place behind a marble pillar, they spy on the Spartan Academy guys as they construct their Thanksgiving Day parade float.
Time to play as Kay and pull a great prank!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Whoa... Everything is so tidy, and this campus is huge! These Spartan guys really are rich!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Whatever. It's not like they can buy their way out of getting pranked. Now `shh...` I want to hear what they're saying.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. It's not like they can buy their way out of getting pranked. Now [color=#3b78e2][i]shh...[/i][/color] I want to hear what they're saying.

nodes.text: Nearby, Chad and Preston work on a float shaped like a Grecian temple. It's decorated with sprigs of autumn foliage.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hey, Preston. I'm liking putting together this harvest-themed Parthenon float for the parade, but I still don't get what's so great about the Thanksgiving holiday.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I mean, I've already got everything I could ever want. What's left to be thankful for?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Exactly, Chad! See you've forgotten how fabulous your life is. That's what happens when you're scandalously rich.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: And that's why we `always` participate in the Thanksgiving Day parade.
nodes.text_bbcode: And that's why we [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] participate in the Thanksgiving Day parade.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You see, when all the common people see how much cool stuff we have, their sad, discouraged faces remind us how great our lives really are.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh, I get it! Just like the Pilgrims did with the Indians. I guess our forefathers really did have everything figured out. Sweet!
Back in their hiding place, Kel winces in disgust.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Ew! These guys are total jerks. If we had principles, that'd be reason enough to prank them.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Heh... Well, I'm ready, but I'll need you to make some kind of distraction so that I can get close to their float.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No problem! I'm on it!
Kel scrambles off. A moment later, an alarm siren sounds from across the school grounds!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: What the...?! Someone's tampering with the armory!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: No! Not our precious fencing foils!
The Spartan Academy guys race off. When the coast is clear, Kay sneaks over to the float with a burlap sack full of squirming animals.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now to put these `lizards` I borrowed from the Centerscore terrarium to good use...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now to put these [color=#3b78e2][i]lizards[/i][/color] I borrowed from the Centerscore terrarium to good use...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I'll hide them onboard the float now, and later, the commotion of the Thanksgiving Day parade will make them reveal themselves!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is a time of year to be grateful for all the wonderful things we have, not plotting revenge...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know about you, but I'd feel pretty grateful for some revenge right about now.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hear! Hear!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm trying, but it must be very quiet!
$ZOE takes the stage next to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guys, listen to Howard... We've put a lot of effort into our float, and whoever pranked us didn't do very much damage to it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are we going to waste the rest of the day in some dumb prank war, or are we going to present the very best float in the parade?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...I hate to say it, guys, but I think $ZOE might be right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, sure, whoever pranked us cut through a few ropes... But big deal! We can repair that easy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why not show them up by putting together the very best float in the parade?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...I hate to say it, guys, but I think Howard might be right.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Because we're about to pull the biggest prank the town of Centerscore has ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Whoa. Really?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Think about it. Centerscore High thinks Wilson High pranked them, and now they're really mad!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But it doesn't have to end there. What happens if we also prank the other high schools?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...They'd be mad, too?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yep. Here's the plan. First, we'll prank Spartan Academy and frame Centerscore High for it...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Then, we'll prank Wilson High and frame Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And finally, we'll prank Monarch Prep and frame Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Wait. Shouldn't we frame Monarch Prep for a prank, too?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, except we're hitting them last, so we'd have to double back... And besides, no one would ever believe that cute, innocent girls would start a prank war.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...But we're cute, innocent girls.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Heh. My point exactly.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I don't know. You're talking about a really big prank, Kay. What happens if Mom and Dad find out?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who cares if they do? Who cares `what` they think? They just want to replace us anyhow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Who cares if they do? Who cares [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] they think? They just want to replace us anyhow.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now let's get started... First stop, Spartan Academy. We just need to swing by the Centerscore High terrarium on the way there.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...The terrarium? Why?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't worry, Kel... `You'll see.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry, Kel... [color=#3b78e2][i]You'll see.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Centerscore High students gather in their gym to listen to $Scott speak...
Play as Howard and try to talk them out of escalating the violence.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ladies, gentlemen, inflatable school mascots...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Today, our way of life, our very freedom, came under attack in a deliberate, amateur, and potentially super-embarrassing prank...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: None of us will ever forget this afternoon, yet we `will` go forward to defend this school...
nodes.text_bbcode: None of us will ever forget this afternoon, yet we [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] go forward to defend this school...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah! We'll show those Wilson High guys what for!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... What is what for?
Dex stares at Amanda blankly.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Oh. Does everybody else know but me? This is worse than the time I thought the Senior Prom was at the Senior Center.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...At least then I got to visit Grandpa!
From the sidelines, Howard and $ZOE watch the crowd grow angrier.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess... It's just everybody is getting really heated, and something about that prank didn't feel right to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, of course not. It's supposed to be upsetting. It's a prank.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but there's something I can't quite put my finger on... Sure, Wilson High has a long history of sabotaging us...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But there was something about this time that felt... I dunno, weirdly `personal...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But there was something about this time that felt... I dunno, weirdly [color=#e23b3b][i]personal...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to try to cool things off...
Howard takes the stage opposite $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, I know you're all mad...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Uh, no. We're `way` beyond mad...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Uh, no. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] beyond mad...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right, okay, but before we do anything rash, we need to consider that...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I mean, how will Howard know how mad we are at him if he doesn't even know we pranked him?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Kay, what are you talking about?! The first rule of pranking is 'don't get caught'.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And the second rule is 'when in doubt, use a banana peel'.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...But that second rule doesn't apply here, so I'm gonna stick with the first one. 'Don't get caught'.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...You're right, Kel. It's probably for the best that Howard doesn't know we pranked him yet...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Totally! The first rule of pranking is 'don't get caught'.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If they blame Wilson, we'll be in the clear.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...But even so. If Howard blames Wilson High, he'll never know how upset we are, and wasn't that the whole point of pranking him?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Trust me. Howard will know. They'll `all` know...
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me. Howard will know. They'll [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] know...

nodes.text: Kay sneaks by the unsuspecting students and saws clumsily at the tie-lines until...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! I think we're ready to get started!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh oh. They're about to fill up the balloon with helium, but I only managed to cut through two of the tie-lines.
Kay rejoins Kel at their original hiding place.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I did my part. I tied the rope to Howard's ankle. What about you?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, I... I almost did some damage.
Nearby, $Scott and Angie inspect the float.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, the Thanksgiving Day parade starts in a few hours, Angie. Will we be ready?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We should be. We've finished work on the giant, inflatable Lyle the Lizard balloon, and we've tethered the balloon to our float.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Once we're finished with the Horn of Plenty, we'll be ready to fill up the balloon with helium and get moving.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Great!
Leaves rustle in the shrubbery behind $Scott. Two pairs of eyes peer out. It's Kay and Kel!
Let's get back to playing as Kay and see what she has planned.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've been going out for a while now, Howard. You still think I don't know what happened between you and Linda?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. I mean, I know that you do, but... What I'm trying to say is... Um, you had to be there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Fine. We don't have to talk about it, if you don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think seeing me here, helping `you` with the float, reminded Linda that I didn't help out the last time there was a big parade.
nodes.text_bbcode: I think seeing me here, helping [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] with the float, reminded Linda that I didn't help out the last time there was a big parade.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Oh. Why didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know exactly. I guess I got busy, and I just... Messed up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the important thing is I really want to be here with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for confiding in me, Howard. I know that must've been difficult for you.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So then... It's settled. Thanksgiving is over...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let `Pranksgiving` begin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Let [color=#3b78e2][i]Pranksgiving[/i][/color] begin!

nodes.text: Whoa! Looks like the twins could use some time to cool down. Let's take a break from them and see what's going on with Howard...
Howard walks up to the front lawn of Centerscore High and joins the students working on their school float.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow! $ZOE, you and the rest of the cheerleaders are doing a great job on the float, and `whoa...` Is that a giant, inflatable Lyle the Lizard balloon?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! $ZOE, you and the rest of the cheerleaders are doing a great job on the float, and [color=#e23b3b][i]whoa...[/i][/color] Is that a giant, inflatable Lyle the Lizard balloon?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! It was $Scott's idea! We're going to tether it to the float and let it fly above us during the parade!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Cool! Well, I brought the supplies you needed for the Horn of Plenty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perfect! Thanks for bringing all that stuff, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I'm happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmph! That's not what you said `last time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmph! That's not what you said [color=#3b78e2][i]last time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Linda, I already apologized for that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whatever. Just do us all a favor and watch out for Wilson. I wouldn't be surprised if those jerks tried something again.
Linda storms off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow. What did you do to rub Linda the wrong way?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Run away? But running away never solves anything!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: When we ran away last time, did we get the man-eating attack unicorn we wanted for our birthday?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And the time before that, did we get the backhoe we needed to dig the shark moat around our treehouse?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I know we didn't, but...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If it didn't work any of those times, why would it work this time?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What we need to do is stand our ground! If Mom and Dad and Howard are going to ruin our Thanksgiving, we should ruin theirs, too!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I say we get the shortest end of the shortiest stick we can find...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And then use that stick to jab them right in their Thanksgiving cheer!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Why should they be happy when `we're` miserable? If Mom and Dad and Howard are going to ruin our Thanksgiving, we should ruin theirs, too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Why should they be happy when [color=#3b78e2][i]we're[/i][/color] miserable? If Mom and Dad and Howard are going to ruin our Thanksgiving, we should ruin theirs, too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think you two should try to look on the bright side.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now you'll finally know what it's like to have a younger sibling put crickets in `your` peanut butter and jelly sandwiches. Ha!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you'll finally know what it's like to have a younger sibling put crickets in [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] peanut butter and jelly sandwiches. Ha!

nodes.text: Howard hops into his car and speeds off.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Grr... Stupid Howard. We were trying to do him a favor.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, crickets are high in protein.
Kay and Kel slouch down on the curb.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess that's it then. There's nothing we can do. This is officially the worst Thanksgiving ever.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah. Mom and Dad get their new baby. Howard gets to have fun at the parade. All we get is the short end of the stick.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: 'Short end of the stick'? What's that even mean?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I don't know, but it's what Dad always says he gets when things are unfair, and right now, things are `mega`-unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, but it's what Dad always says he gets when things are unfair, and right now, things are [color=#3b78e2][i]mega[/i][/color]-unfair!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But wait! We could still show them. We could...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You want to put our new sibling up for adoption?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, we have to get rid of it somehow... And it's not like we can just put it in a box and mail it to Malaysia!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We don't have nearly that many stamps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls, we're not putting your baby sister up for adoption or mailing her or doing anything else to her!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All we're going to do is be happy for Mom and Dad.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `No buts.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No buts.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Why?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Duh... We'll spread it around the backyard to lure the stork into a trap.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Then once we catch him, we'll put bubble gum in his feathers until he agrees to take the baby back to where he got it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Oh! Heh. That's pretty funny.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, girls, the truth is, there's a whole lot you two don't know about how babies get made...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Nuh unh! We know everything. We know there's a garden where babies grow inside heads of lettuce...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And if a mommy kisses a daddy, the stork takes one of the lettuce babies and shoves it into the mommy's belly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, that's, uh...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What? Did we leave something out?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um, no, you're, uh, absolutely correct...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But since you know everything about babies, you also know that, once the process starts, there's nothing you can do to stop it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, I... I guess we forgot about that part.
Howard suddenly stiffens. His eyes go wide.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second! You said Mom was feeling sick... In the morning... As in `morning sickness...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second! You said Mom was feeling sick... In the morning... As in [color=#e23b3b][i]morning sickness...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, that's, um, very astute, Howard, but I'll need to consult with your mother before I can formally confirm or deny that...
Cathy enters the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's okay, Horace. We'd been hoping to keep this a surprise until tonight, but I guess the secret's out.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Children, I'm pregnant. And I have a feeling it's a girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow! Congratulations, Mom! When is she...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NO!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: `NOT FAIR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOT FAIR!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, what on earth's gotten into you?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're the littlest kids in the family. You can't just replace us!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Nobody is being replaced. We're just adding a bundle of joy to the family. Don't you understand?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We understand that we don't want any bundles of anything that's not fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Really big, explodey fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And definitely no new baby sisters!
Kay and Kel storm out of the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...Well, all things considered, I think that went pretty well.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace, what are you talking about? The twins are extremely upset.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sure, but they didn't release any wild, hungry animals into the house, did they? That means everything's still...
An enormous raccoon skitters through the kitchen and into the pantry. It hungrily burrows into a box of cereal!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess they really `are` upset.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sigh... I guess they really [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] upset.

nodes.text: As Horace and Cathy sweep up inside, Kay and Kel regroup in the front yard.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did you see that? Our parents are trying to get rid of us!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: They're trying to replace us with a new baby girl!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard has to see what's happening. He'll help us!
Howard walks out to his car, carrying materials for the Centerscore High School float.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard! Howard, you have to help us!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, help you do what?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Get rid of the baby!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, we need you to...

options.label: Get bird feed for the stork.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: About you?! What right does anybody have to criticize my own flesh and blood?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But it was actually kind of our...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Immaterial! If somebody's going to punish my daughters, that somebody should be me!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Don't you worry, girls. Somebody at that school's going to get an earful over this outrage!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: In the meantime, you two should just do your best to enjoy the holiday.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Thanks, Dad!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, you're the best!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, what was wrong with it?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, one of the parents complained that it was sending the wrong message.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: I see. Well, it's important to be sensitive when depicting Native Americans in drama these days.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No, that's not it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Devon's mom didn't like how we brought in real bows and arrows and wild turkeys to make depictions of early American life more `authentic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Devon's mom didn't like how we brought in real bows and arrows and wild turkeys to make depictions of early American life more [color=#3b78e2][i]authentic.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And she especially didn't like how Devon ended up with puncture wounds and a mouth full of feathers.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sigh... I'll call your teacher later. Maybe we can work something out.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: In the meantime, you two better stay out of trouble during your day off.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Okay.
It's Thanksgiving morning in Centerscore, and it's the start of a day brimming with hope and possibilities!
Two young twins, Kay and Kel, race down the stairs and into the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Mom, we want our Thanksgiving harvest waffles!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah! Feed us! We want...
Instead of their mother, Horace stands at the stove!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Hey, kids! Who wants flipjacks?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Don't you mean flapjacks?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Flip. Flap. Really, what's the difference if you can't scrape it off the bottom of the skillet? Somebody find me a scapula!
Howard enters the dining room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I really hope you meant `spatula`, Dad, and it's in the top left drawer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I really hope you meant [color=#e23b3b][i]spatula[/i][/color], Dad, and it's in the top left drawer.

nodes.text: Kay, Kel, and Howard take their seats at the breakfast table.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey! How come Mom isn't cooking us breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, Mom makes a really great Thanksgiving-y breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, well, your mother's just feeling a little sick this morning, so I thought I'd treat you all to my world-famous Pumpkin Pancake Stack!
Horace swings his skillet about in wild gyrations. The burnt pancake does a half-hearted somersault.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, then how come Jean-Paul isn't making us French toast?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: He said something about not understanding our crazy, turkey-centered holiday and ran off to get a crepe.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: So until Jean-Paul gets back or until your mother feels better, you're stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Anyway, do you kids have any big plans for Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, yeah! All the high schools in town are putting together floats of their school mascots for the Thanksgiving Day parade!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: That sounds fun. Kay and Kel, you're in a play at your elementary school, right?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We were supposed to be, but the play got canceled.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: One of the parents complained...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Okay, so we tried our best, but we didn't end up actually pranking any of the schools.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: ...And that was our final high school float, ladies and gentlemen. Moving on...
Howard turns back to the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now listen up! Anybody who wants a piece of them is going to have to come through me first!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Not at all. I'm very, very mad at you. What you did was absolutely terrible, and I'm going to make sure you get punished.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But as mad as I am... I forgive you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course, I do, and I always will.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I'm not happy about what you did, but nothing is going to change the fact that you two are family.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...We love you too, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Even if we don't always show it.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Not just Wilson. They pranked Spartan Academy, too! Get 'em!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You mean those little girls were the ones who pranked Spartan Academy?
The Judge strokes his chin thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hm, let me see if I understand correctly.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: You all say you were pranked, yet you also all claim to be innocent of any wrongdoing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Actually, it does sound kind of funny when you put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Tell me. Which school was pranked first?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, we were, I think. Somebody sabotaged our Lyle the Lizard balloon, and nearly hurt Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `did` think it was kind of weird that I got singled out, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] think it was kind of weird that I got singled out, but...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Tell me, son. Have you made anyone angry recently?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, I mean, nobody but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh! The twins were really mad this morning, but they wouldn't have gone so far as to...
Kay leaps out and points a finger at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yes, we would! Mom and Dad are trying to replace us!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, and `you` didn't do anything about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] didn't do anything about it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, don't you understand? That's not what's happening at all.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Even if the Monarch Prep float `was` a mite peculiar...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if the Monarch Prep float [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] a mite peculiar...

nodes.text: Some time later...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, I'm very impressed, kids. That might've been the best Thanksgiving Day parade this town has ever had!
As their butterfly float flaps its wings, clumps of sod rain down on the Monarch Prep students!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahh! Ahh! This is terrible! How can I look cute, when I'm covered in dirt! What's happening?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: What's happening...?! We've been pranked by Wilson High is what. See? This is the same dirt they used to construct their badger den float!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... `Not cool.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... [color=#3b78e2][i]Not cool.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, let's all thank Monarch Prep for effectively demonstrating that our forefathers lived in much, um, filthier times...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: So we should all be thankful for our modern hygiene.
Suddenly, hundreds of lizards burst out and overrun the float!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ahh! `Ahh!` We've been infested by reptiles!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahh! [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh![/i][/color] We've been infested by reptiles!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What the...?! Lizards?! Those Centerscore High losers must've pranked us...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, I'm not exactly sure what lizards gone amok have to do with Thanksgiving...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: So we'll move on to our final high school presenting today...
The animatronic Barry the Badger mascot pops right out of the badger den and sparks uncontrollably! There is a Grecian spear stuck through its chest!

nodes.speaker: Barry
nodes.text: Kzzt! H-h-happy... Kzzt! H-h-happy... Kzzt!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: ...Is our float supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: No, you idiot! We've been pranked by Spartan Academy!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, that's, uh... Something...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: It appears Wilson High may be having some technical difficulties. Moving on...
A few minutes later, Kay and Kel walk to the parade forming in the Centerscore town square...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Yeah. I guess there's nothing left to do now, but watch the Thanksgiving Day parade.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I give you the `Spartan High Spartans...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I give you the [color=#e23b3b][i]Spartan High Spartans...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chad and Preston lead the procession of Spartan High students wearing togas and their autumn-themed Parthenon float.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Last but not least, I give you all the `Monarch Preparatory Butterflies...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Last but not least, I give you all the [color=#e23b3b][i]Monarch Preparatory Butterflies...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige and Penelope lead the procession of Monarch Prep students dressed in Native American garb.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...What?! What went wrong?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...I guess none of our pranks were good enough to stop people from celebrating.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I know, we made some mistakes, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, forget it. Let's go home.
Kay and Kel trudge off in somber silence.
That night, at Thanksgiving dinner...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...And we're also thankful for our son, Howard, who was part of that terrific parade today...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: ...And our two lovely daughters, Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And speaking of Kay and Kel... After that little scene you made this morning, we thought for sure you two would get up to trouble.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: But we were extremely pleased to see you show so much restraint!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But we didn't...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We actually tried to...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now now, don't sell yourself short. You two demonstrated a great deal of emotional maturity today.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Which is why we've decided to let the new babies share `your` room.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is why we've decided to let the new babies share [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] room.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You... You want us to... Gulp... Share?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And did you just say '`babies`'?! I thought there was just the one.
nodes.text_bbcode: And did you just say '[color=#3b78e2][i]babies[/i][/color]'?! I thought there was just the one.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, didn't we tell you? The doctor made a mistake. Instead of one baby girl, we're having boy quintuplets!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Yep! Your mother's giving me a whole basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa! With five identical brothers, I guess being `twins` won't seem so special anymore, huh?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! With five identical brothers, I guess being [color=#e23b3b][i]twins[/i][/color] won't seem so special anymore, huh?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...No, I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Not in the slightest.
Kay and Kel excuse themselves from the table and slink to their bedrooms.
They sit silently on their beds and pout.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Worst. Thanksgiving. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: For. Sure.
You know, we usually don't agree with Kay and Kel... But seriously, this is an episode called `Pranksgiving`, and you ruined the pranks?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, we usually don't agree with Kay and Kel... But seriously, this is an episode called [b]Pranksgiving[/b], and you ruined the pranks?!

nodes.text: What happened?! Were you still sleepy from eating all that turkey?
Get up, shake out that tryptophan, and play again! And this time, you need to do a whole lot better!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: Suddenly, the parade erupts in a massive brawl! Pumpkins, Pilgrim hats, Indian headdresses, and bales of hay fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, I never...! What on earth's going on here?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What happened?! Wilson High pranked our float is what happened! We're just retaliating!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What were we thinking? We forgot the first rule of pranking!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're not supposed to get caught!
Howard puts himself between the onrushing crowd and Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Stay behind me, girls! I'll handle this.
Howard calls out to the angry crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Everybody, just calm down! Sure, my sisters pranked us, and we're upset about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the truth is, this is partly my fault.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My sisters found out our mother is having a new baby, and they think it will make them less special.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And when they came to me for guidance, I made fun of them instead of explaining the truth.
Howard turns to look at Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You see, the truth is having more family doesn't make you any less special... It makes you `more` special.
nodes.text_bbcode: You see, the truth is having more family doesn't make you any less special... It makes you [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] special.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It means you have more people who care about you, more people who want what's best for you.
Howard glances toward $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And trust me, I've learned today that not having your family around is really, really hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, are you saying you...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's watch the Thanksgiving Day parade to see what happens next!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Okay, so we totally pranked Wilson High, Spartan Academy, and Monarch Prep!
A short while later, Howard and $ZOE join their fellow Centerscore High students and the students from the other local high schools at the parade starting line.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you know, if you wanted to head home, no one would blame you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know I'm not exactly in the mood to party, but anything's better than being by myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, I'm a cheerleader. It's my job to get crowds excited!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...I guess I didn't think about that.
On a nearby stage, Judge Tigh prepares to speak.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hello, and welcome to the annual Centerscore Thanksgiving Day parade!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Not to go overboard here, but I know this parade is the high point of Thanksgiving for many of you.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That's why, this year, we've asked our town's four high schools to present floats based on their school mascots.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Okay, kids! Let's see what you've got!
In their hiding place beneath the speaker's podium, Kay and Kel watch the parade.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This is it! It's time!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: First up, I give you the `Centerscore Lizards...`

nodes.text: ...Seriously?!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Uh, are you doing that?!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh

nodes.speaker: Tom

nodes.speaker: Paige

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: ...Look at us all. I'm so ashamed.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: We got all worked up over a ruined parade when the real meaning of Thanksgiving was right here the whole time.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Family, friends, being there for each other... That's what matters. That and knowing it can all be taken away at any time by forces beyond our control.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Go home, children! I'm sure your parents are worried sick about you.

nodes.text: We just love you girls so much, and we don't know what we'd do without you.

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we promise to be great big sisters, too!

nodes.text: Heh... I guess I am pretty awesome.

nodes.text: Seriously, though, who else could've convinced the judge to let you off with just fifteen hours of community service?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, okay, kids. We've talked enough. I think it's time to dig into this wonderful Thanksgiving meal your mother prepared for us!

nodes.text: $ZOE, you're our guest. Would you like the first serving of turkey?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sigh...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sigh... Of course, we do.
And there you have it!
